title: Success 2.0: Getting to the Top and Staying There

sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。
我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantam）。

sentences.en: In the late 16th century, a playwright named Thomas Kidd wrote a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 16世纪末，一位名叫托马斯·基德（Thomas Kidd）的剧作家写了一部悲剧。

sentences.en: It was about an aristocrat who seeks revenge after his son is murdered.
sentences.zh: 故事讲述了一位贵族在儿子被谋杀后寻求复仇的经历。

sentences.en: The play was called The Spanish Tragedy, and it is still produced occasionally today.
sentences.zh: 这部剧名为《西班牙悲剧》（The Spanish Tragedy），至今仍偶尔上演。

sentences.en: What outcries plucked me from my naked bed and chilled my throbbing heart with trembling fear,
sentences.zh: 是什么样的呐喊将我从赤裸的床上惊醒，又用颤栗的恐惧冷彻我悸动的心，

sentences.en: which never danger yet could daunt before.
sentences.zh: 而此前从未有危险能让我如此胆寒。

sentences.en: Thomas Kidd's play was popular in its day.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·基德的剧作在当时很受欢迎。

sentences.en: But unless you're an Elizabethan scholar, you probably haven't heard of the playwright.
sentences.zh: 但除非你是伊丽莎白时代的学者，否则你可能没听说过这位剧作家。

sentences.en: You may have heard about one of his contemporaries, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，你可能听说过他的一位同时代人。

sentences.en: As Thomas Kidd's career flatlined after the Spanish Tragedy,
sentences.zh: 当托马斯·基德的事业在《西班牙悲剧》之后陷入停滞时，
莎士比亚却写出了一部又一部杰作。

sentences.en: Reason and love keep little company together nowadays.
sentences.zh: 如今，理智与爱情很少结伴而行。

sentences.en: Followed by historical dramas and more.
Love is not love which alters when its alteration finds or bends with the remover to remove.
sentences.zh: 爱并非爱，当它发现改变时便改变，或随那改变者而弯曲。

sentences.en: Shakespeare's plays have been translated into dozens of languages.
sentences.zh: 莎士比亚的剧作已被翻译成几十种语言。

sentences.en: They continue to be performed 400 years after he wrote them.
sentences.zh: 在他创作400年后，它们仍在继续上演。

sentences.en: Even more than that, his words have become so much a part of our lives that we all quote him without realizing it.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他的话语已深深融入我们的生活，以至于我们都在不知不觉中引用他。

sentences.en: Love is blind comes from Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: “爱情是盲目的”出自莎士比亚。

sentences.en: So does fainthearted and sea change and too much of a good thing.
sentences.zh: “胆怯”、“沧海桑田”以及“过犹不及”也是如此。

sentences.en: When you say all that glitters isn't gold or there's method in his madness, you're quoting Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 当你引用“闪光的未必都是金子”或“疯狂中自有条理”时，你就是在引用莎士比亚。

sentences.en: What explains the gulf between Thomas Kidd's one-hit wonder playwriting career and William Shakespeare's sustained success?
sentences.zh: 是什么解释了托马斯·基德“昙花一现”的剧作生涯与威廉·莎士比亚持续成功之间的鸿沟？

sentences.en: And what explains the similar chasms we see between performers in many domains today?
sentences.zh: 又是什么解释了当今许多领域表演者之间类似的巨大差距？

sentences.en: In art and in sports and in music.
sentences.zh: 在艺术、体育和音乐领域都是如此。
是什么造就了莎士比亚？
或者说，是什么造就了迈克尔·乔丹？
又是什么造就了泰勒·斯威夫特？

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we wrap up our series, Success 2.0, with new research that aims to unpack a mystery.
sentences.zh: 本周在《隐藏的大脑》中，我们将以一项旨在揭开谜团的新研究，结束我们的“成功2.0”系列。

sentences.en: What's the secret to repeated and enduring success?
sentences.zh: 重复且持久成功的秘诀是什么？

sentences.en: In a number of fields of human performance, success is distributed very unevenly.
sentences.zh: 在许多人类表现领域，成功分布得非常不均匀。

sentences.en: Mathematicians call these power law distributions.
sentences.zh: 数学家称之为幂律分布。

sentences.en: If you look at all the accomplishments in a given field, Emmy Awards, Super Bowl championships, hit plays,
sentences.zh: 如果你审视特定领域的所有成就——艾美奖、超级碗冠军、热门剧作，

sentences.en: a handful of superstars account for a disproportionate share of the spoils.
sentences.zh: 少数超级巨星占据了不成比例的战利品份额。

sentences.en: The rest of us are lucky to even have fleeting success.
sentences.zh: 我们其余的人能有片刻的成功就已是万幸。

sentences.en: Most writers, for example, never get their books published.
sentences.zh: 例如，大多数作家从未出版过自己的书。

sentences.en: Of the ones that do, a small number become bestsellers.
sentences.zh: 而在出版了书的作家中，只有少数成为了畅销书作家。

sentences.en: And among the writers who produce bestsellers, a very tiny fraction go on to produce lots and lots of bestsellers.
sentences.zh: 而在创作畅销书的作家中，只有极小一部分能持续创作出大量畅销书。

sentences.en: Most basketball players never end up in the NBA.
sentences.zh: 大多数篮球运动员最终都进不了NBA。

sentences.en: But of those who do, a small number becomes stars, and a very tiny fraction of those become household names.
sentences.zh: 但在进入NBA的球员中，少数成为了明星，而其中极小一部分成为了家喻户晓的名字。

sentences.en: Well, you might say, I know why Shakespeare and Taylor Swift are so popular.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可能会说，我知道为什么莎士比亚和泰勒·斯威夫特这么受欢迎。

sentences.en: But the chasm between total obscurity and being a one-hit wonder,
sentences.zh: 但从默默无闻到昙花一现的鸿沟，

sentences.en: and the chasm between being a one-hit wonder and those who have sustained success,
sentences.zh: 以及从昙花一现到持续成功之间的鸿沟，

sentences.en: is so great that luck and talent seem like incomplete explanations.
sentences.zh: 是如此之大，以至于运气和才华似乎是并不完整的解释。

sentences.en: Across many domains, from entertainment to sports to technology,
sentences.zh: 在从娱乐到体育再到技术的许多领域，

sentences.en: there are performers, creators, and innovators who seem to have an instinct for greatness.
sentences.zh: 都有表演者、创作者和创新者似乎拥有对卓越的本能。

sentences.en: What can we learn from them?
sentences.zh: 我们能从他们身上学到什么？

sentences.en: Today, we'll explore the psychology of creativity and success
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将探索创造力和成功的心理学，

sentences.en: by examining the stories of two filmmakers whose work you know.
sentences.zh: 通过审视两位你所熟知的电影制作人的故事。

sentences.en: Their story begins some 50 years ago.
In the summer of 1977, a quirky sci-fi film became a global phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 1977年夏天，一部古怪的科幻电影成为了全球现象。

sentences.en: Star Wars was a story about an intergalactic civil war.
sentences.zh: 《星球大战》讲述了一个星际内战的故事。

sentences.en: It was packed with lots of drama and even more action.
sentences.zh: 它充满了戏剧性，动作场面更是数不胜数。
我和本·克诺比一起来的。
片中有外星人、宇宙飞船、光剑。

sentences.en: And of course, there was the Force, a mysterious energy that bound the universe.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有“原力”，一种束缚宇宙的神秘能量。

sentences.en: The Force will be with you.

sentences.zh: 这部电影票房收入超过4亿美元。

sentences.en: Its writer, director, and proprietor, George Lucas,
sentences.zh: 其编剧、导演兼拥有者乔治·卢卡斯，

sentences.zh: 是南加州大学电影学院的毕业生。

sentences.en: After his massive success, he began planning the sequel to Star Wars.
sentences.zh: 在取得巨大成功后，他开始筹划《星球大战》的续集。

sentences.en: The movie was titled The Empire Strikes Back.
George Lucas wanted to build an entire franchise around Star Wars,
sentences.zh: 乔治·卢卡斯想围绕《星球大战》建立一个完整的系列，

sentences.en: but he didn't want to direct the sequel himself.
sentences.zh: 但他不想亲自执导续集。

sentences.en: He set his heart on an alternate director,
a professor at USC who had made an impression on him in film school.
sentences.zh: 一位在电影学院给他留下深刻印象的南加州大学教授。

sentences.en: The professor wasn't a Star Wars fan.
sentences.zh: 这位教授不是《星球大战》的粉丝。

sentences.en: In fact, Irwin Kirshner thought George Lucas was out of his mind.
sentences.zh: 事实上，欧文·克什纳（Irwin Kirshner）认为乔治·卢卡斯疯了。

sentences.en: He had formed this impression before the original movie was released,
sentences.zh: 他在原版电影上映前就形成了这种印象，

sentences.en: Of course, Irwin Kirshner was wrong.
But when George Lucas asked him to direct The Empire Strikes Back, he said no.
sentences.zh: 但当乔治·卢卡斯请他执导《帝国反击战》时，他拒绝了。

sentences.en: In time, however, he gave in.
sentences.zh: 不过最终，他还是妥协了。

sentences.zh: 加入我，我们可以以父子的身份共同统治银河系。

sentences.en: Like Star Wars, it became a smashing success.
sentences.zh: 像《星球大战》一样，它取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: It was the highest-grossing film in 1980 and earned over $400 million worldwide.
sentences.zh: 它是1980年票房最高的电影，全球收入超过4亿美元。

sentences.en: Together, Irwin Kirshner and George Lucas made what some argue is the greatest film in the Star Wars franchise.
sentences.zh: 欧文·克什纳和乔治·卢卡斯共同打造了被一些人认为是《星球大战》系列中最伟大的电影。

sentences.en: You could say that 1980 was the year of Star Wars.
sentences.zh: 你可以说1980年是《星球大战》之年。

sentences.en: By that same year, another film made its way into theaters.
sentences.zh: 就在同一年，另一部电影进入了影院。

sentences.en: Used Cars was a lowbrow comedy that followed the story of a sleazy car salesman who had dreams of getting into politics.
sentences.zh: 《二手车》（Used Cars）是一部低俗喜剧，讲述了一个梦想进入政界的卑劣汽车推销员的故事。

sentences.en: It was packed with raunch and gallows humor.
sentences.zh: 它充满了粗俗和黑色幽默。

sentences.en: I talked to the party chairman last week.
sentences.zh: 我上周和党主席谈过了。

sentences.en: $60,000 buys me the nomination, and I'm going to show it.

sentences.en: Bad, you know, down payments, you know.

sentences.zh: 一旦我进去，我拿到的所有贿赂都五五分成。

sentences.zh: 感觉像是把三部电影塞进了一部里。

sentences.en: A manic energy runs through the film, and the story flies off in different directions.
sentences.zh: 影片中贯穿着一种狂躁的能量，故事向不同的方向飞去。

sentences.en: The characters are highly driven, but also unpleasant.

sentences.zh: 影评人罗杰·伊伯特（Roger Ebert）给了这部电影四星中的两星。

sentences.en: He said there were too many plot lines, too many characters.

sentences.zh: 评论家们抨击了该片的编剧兼导演，一位名叫罗伯特·泽米吉斯（Robert Zemeckis）的年轻电影制作人。

sentences.en: He was a graduate of the USC Film School, too.
sentences.zh: 他也是南加州大学电影学院的毕业生。

sentences.en: But while Irwin Kushner's career choices were careful and meticulous,

sentences.en: Robert Zemeckis liked to push the envelope.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·泽米吉斯喜欢挑战极限。

sentences.zh: 在《二手车》之前，他执导了一部名为《一亲芳泽》（I Want to Hold Your Hand）的音乐片。
